name: packdeck
title: Packdeck - npm Package Manager
description: Search npm packages, manage projects and global packages, run scripts, and check updates and security with a locally installed npm, Yarn, pnpm, or Bun.
author: ricardo_kupper

commands.name: search-packages
commands.title: Search npm Packages
commands.subtitle: Packdeck
commands.description: Search the npm registry, inspect stats and READMEs, and install packages locally or globally

commands.name: manage-projects
commands.title: Manage Projects
commands.subtitle: Packdeck
commands.description: Discover local package.json projects, switch workspaces, and inspect or manage dependencies

commands.name: outdated-packages
commands.title: Check Outdated Packages
commands.subtitle: Packdeck
commands.description: Detect outdated dependencies across projects and perform individual or bulk updates

commands.name: security-audit
commands.title: Run Security Audit
commands.subtitle: Packdeck
commands.description: Scan project dependencies for known security vulnerabilities and apply remediation fixes

commands.name: run-scripts
commands.title: Run Project Scripts
commands.subtitle: Packdeck
commands.description: Discover and execute package.json scripts inline or in your preferred terminal

commands.name: global-packages
commands.title: Manage Global Packages
commands.subtitle: Packdeck
commands.description: View, update, reinstall, install, and uninstall globally installed packages across npm, pnpm, Yarn, and Bun

commands.name: favorites-and-history
commands.title: Favorites & History
commands.subtitle: Packdeck
commands.description: Access bookmarked packages and replay previous installation and management commands

commands.name: menu-bar-status
commands.title: Package Status Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Packdeck
commands.description: Monitor outdated packages and security vulnerabilities in the macOS menu bar with smart notifications

preferences.name: projectDirectories
preferences.title: Project Directories
preferences.description: Comma-separated directories to scan automatically for projects containing package.json.

preferences.name: scanDepth
preferences.title: Project Scan Depth
preferences.description: Maximum folder nesting depth when scanning for package.json files.

preferences.name: defaultPackageManager
preferences.title: Default Package Manager
preferences.description: Fallback package manager when no lockfile or packageManager field is present.

preferences.name: registryUrl
preferences.title: npm Registry URL
preferences.description: Base URL for npm package registry queries.

preferences.name: preferredTerminal
preferences.title: Preferred Terminal
preferences.description: Terminal application used when launching interactive or watch scripts.

preferences.name: preferredEditor
preferences.title: Preferred Code Editor
preferences.description: Code editor used for the Open in Editor action on local projects.

preferences.name: enableNotifications
preferences.title: Smart Notifications
preferences.label: Notify about outdated packages, security vulnerabilities, and completed operations
preferences.description: Show system notifications when background checks discover new issues or long operations finish.

preferences.name: additionalPath
preferences.title: Additional PATH Entries
preferences.description: Optional colon-separated directories appended to PATH when locating Node and package manager CLIs.
